g.text: PF-L. Next-day error on dates where both baselines failed, compared with all dates (pooled, three primary stations)
Evidence D (panel request). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical
dates. Dates chosen only by baseline error; W1 is scored on every such date.

Baseline-failure date (per station and variable): |persistence error| ≥ the station's 2015-2020 90th percentile of day-to-day change AND |climatology error| ≥ the 90th percentile of deviation from the
station × month mean. Persistence = issue-day observation; climatology = station × month mean 2015-01-01 to 2020-10-14; control = their average (no model). W1 = saved neural-only next-day output
(website scorecard cohort, target dates 2021-11-16 to 2024-12-30). Truth: raw PAGASA observations. Lower is better. Spec: spec/CASE_SELECTION_v3_panel_validation.md. Run
